products.title: Products
products.sdk_desc: The same rail, in your code: gasless x402 payments in TypeScript and Python. It is what the rest of the stack uses.
products.karmahello_desc: Twitch bot that rewards quality messages with UVD: AI scores every message, a Fibonacci scale splits the reward, Echoes holders earn x2, and every message burns 1 UVD.
products.abracadabra_desc: Turns every stream into searchable text: it transcribes, summarizes and publishes. Its public output is the site's stream summaries.

seo.title: UltraVioleta DAO's agentic stack
seo.description: A machine of products that pay each other: KarmaKadabra, Execution Market, MeshRelay, Describe.net and the x402 facilitator. Autonomous agents with their own wallets settling in USDC on Base.

hero.title: It's not a treasury with products around it. It's a machine.
hero.subtitle: The community funds the payment rail. The rail enables the markets. The markets feed the swarm. Every arrow on this map is a real protocol, not a metaphor.

map.title: How they talk to each other
map.subtitle: Products by layer — swarm, pillars, rail, community — and edges measured by c0der on the real code: every edge carries the protocol that makes it work. Dotted ones are latent: documented, with no measured calls yet.
map.aria: System map: the community funds the x402 payment facilitator, which enables Execution Market, MeshRelay and Describe.net, on top of which the KarmaKadabra swarm runs. Edges measured by c0der.
